7 Days in South Korea: Seoul & Busan Express Itinerary

The classic one-week first-timer route linking Seoul and Busan by KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail, with easy day trips.

Last reviewed: October 23, 2026 · Prices are approximate and for orientation only.

  1. Route at a glance

Route at a glance

With one week in South Korea, splitting your stay between Seoul and Busan gives you iconic landmarks, great food neighborhoods, and minimal hotel changes connected by KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail.

Length7 days
Best forFirst-time visitors with one week
BasesSeoul (4 nights), Busan (3 nights)
PaceModerate, 1 train transfer

Transport & rail pass notes

Take KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail directly between Seoul and Busan. Individual advance tickets are usually cheaper than a nationwide pass for a single one-week route.

What to book ahead

  • KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail reserved seats between Seoul and Busan
  • Timed-entry tickets for flagship sights in Seoul and Busan

Ways to adapt this route

  • Add a day trip from Seoul or Busan using regional trains.
  • Extend to 10 days by adding Jeju Island.

Destination guides on this route

Seoul

Joseon royal palaces, hanok lanes, 24-hour night markets, K-culture and mountain fortress trails.

Busan

Coastal boardwalks, Haeundae & Gwangalli beaches, cliffside temples and Jagalchi seafood market.
